$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (endoflife-date-source, part 1/2). Declares the eolProduct/eolCycle schemas (register openconnector, per openconnector-register-schema REQ-A-001's single-register-per-app convention) and seeds the pre-built, credential-free `endoflife-date` source plus a curated starter set of 8 `eolProduct` objects (static catalog metadata). See openspec/changes/endoflife-date-source/design.md Decisions 1, 3, 8. The per-product mapping/synchronization/job triples that populate `eolCycle` live in the companion fragment endoflife-date-source-cycles.json, kept separate for reviewability (tasks.md Task 2).

eolProduct.title: EOL Product
eolProduct.summary: A tracked product/technology whose release-cycle lifecycle data is sourced from endoflife.date
eolProduct.description: Static catalog metadata for one product tracked against the public endoflife.date API. Seeded declaratively (not synced) for the curated starter set, because `/api/all.json` returns a bare array of product-slug strings — structurally incompatible with the generic per-item Synchronization pipeline — and this metadata (name/category/homepage) is static, human-known data with nothing dynamic to discover. See design.md Decision 1.

slug.description: The endoflife.date product identifier — the path segment used to fetch this product's cycles at /api/{slug}.json
slug.title: Slug

eolCycle.title: EOL Cycle
eolCycle.summary: One release-cycle's lifecycle data (release date, EOL, support window) for a tracked eolProduct
eolCycle.description: Populated live by each curated product's dedicated, daily-scheduled Synchronization against https://endoflife.date/api/{slug}.json — never hand-seeded (a static seed here would be immediately stale; see design.md Seed Data). `product` is set as a plain literal string by that product's Mapping (design.md Decision 4), not an OpenRegister relation `$ref`, so each product's Synchronization stays a simple, independent, collision-proof triple (design.md Decision 2 / discovery.md Finding 4).

product.description: The owning eolProduct.slug (e.g. "python") — a literal string set by this cycle's owning product's Mapping
product.title: Product

cycle.description: The release-cycle label as reported by endoflife.date (e.g. "3.14") — the per-product SynchronizationContract origin id
cycle.title: Cycle

releaseDate.description: The date this cycle was first released
releaseDate.title: Release Date

eol.description: ISO end-of-life date, or an empty string when endoflife.date has not scheduled one yet (upstream reports JSON `false`; cast to `string` by the seeded Mapping — design.md Decision 6)
eol.title: End of Life

support.description: ISO end-of-active-support date, or an empty string — same date-or-empty-string shape as `eol`
support.title: Support Ends

latest.description: The latest patch release within this cycle
latest.title: Latest

lts.description: Whether this cycle is Long Term Support. Left uncast (boolean per most products, but occasionally an ISO date upstream — endoflife.date's own mixed shape; design.md Decision 6).
lts.title: LTS

discontinued.description: ISO discontinuation date, or an empty string — same date-or-empty-string shape as `eol`/`support`; not reported for every product/cycle
discontinued.title: Discontinued

objects.name: endoflife.date
objects.description: The public, free, no-auth endoflife.date lifecycle API (https://endoflife.date/api). Unlike a credentialed integration preset (brp-haalcentraal, kvk), this source ships live/enabled — there is nothing an operator needs to configure before it can be used. Consumed by the curated per-product `endoflife-date-*-cycles` Synchronizations declared in the companion fragment endoflife-date-source-cycles.json.
